From: Paula Garrity <IMMIIII

>

Hi! I just arrived for my first visit at the Range Rover dealership in Darien. I was so
excited that it was located right near Equinox...in Orlando I had to drive like 30 minutes.
I walk in to check in...the lady was so mean to me...I got in a huge argument with her and it
was totally her fault. I hate getting my car service as it is...now I have to deal with this
!! I am sure it will be $1000 by the time I walk out of here too! She will probably
tell the service guy to make my tires flat or something!
I sent an email to Robbie to make sure it was fine to give him your number...here it is
early! Ha! I will shoot you back a message as soon as he confirms that it is ok (I am sure
it is) his number is
His fiance's name is Katie...she is a teacher at
Greenwich High School. Sometimes she comes with him and sometimes not. I am sure he won't
bring her the first time. She sometimes comes and sometimes doesn't....very nice.
As for this evening...I think I will just plan to get Henry from Chess Club at 6:15, right
time, right?...that way I can kinda see what they are doing and then Gloryana can just head
home for homework and dinner with Ty. My spray tan is so quick that it is not a big deal to
have Hen come. Thank you though for offering to have him through dinner and all of that.
Spray tan is just over the border in Norwalk on Main St. The girl I go to has her spot in a
tanning salon that is pretty nice. I found her through our old babysitter who always tanned
there. I really like her and her product is really good. I am the queen of
spraytanning...funny, kinda, I know! In Orlando not that weird as everyone preferred to be
tanned as we never wore clothes!! Anyway, when you get used to something it is hard to stop
and I am SO white naturally...I tanned in a booth for so many years (early high school until
well into my 20's)...so awful for me and now I am paying for it with skin cancer
already....another future conversation! Ambur does a great natural color and I never have
streaks, etc. It is just sorta annoying because you stink for 24 hours and then it also can
get on your clothes in certain instances. Anyway, I am a pro so if you ever want to do it I
will give you all the pointers!! It is quite embarrassing that I am a pro...so stupid and I
know it but I can't help myself!! I have yet to see anything strange about you...can you
please tell me one thing so that I don't start having a complex about all of my own
"weirdnesses"!!
Thanks for coming last night...I feel bad when you guys don't get home until later...I don't
want to kick you out but I worry that Ike will be annoyed and that you will stop coming!!
As for Saturday run...I don't want you to feel pressured to worry about running with me...if
it works out then great but if you just need to bust out a run without coordinating with me
so it fits your schedule please know I am the first to understand. I think that time would
work well; however, the only issue that I could foresee is if Pat decides to go to the gym
during that time. I don't like to bother him with regard to his weekend workouts since he
never does it during the week (his only fault, honestly!) so I try to be flexible on the
weekends. I suppose you will probably go regardless so as long as he is home when you are
ready at say 2:45 we can go...otherwise you may have to run solo...does that sound good? As
for Sunday...I probably will take Sunday off as it is my only day off and my body will be
needing it...it needs it today I feel like!!
We will try to hook up at Cherry Street. I also thought about ordering a pizza and just
going to the house...if we do that you guys could just swing by on your way home for a little
bit...no pressure on that either but most likely we will hit CS.
Let Gloryana know that I will get Hen from Chess...I will also text her to thank her for
hosting!!
